facts.fact: The deal record gives the National Digital Plan 2026-2030 (PNN2) as a US$1.5 billion envelope: US$1 billion of government public investment plus US$500 million from external partners (World Bank and AFD) already secured; the record dates the commitment to 2025.

systems.tiers: national; the record describes the DRC Digital Transformation Project as carrying it, with digital ID, data-sharing, e-signature and payment-gateway deliverables
national; US$400 million IDA plus EUR 100 million AFD
